stem: A zookeeper sets up a habitat for a certain species of rabbit. Which answer choice describes the rabbit as it interacts with two nonliving parts of the rabbit’s habitat?

options.label: A
options.text: The rabbit breathing air while running down a rocky path

options.label: B
options.text: The rabbit licking its fur while feeding its young

options.label: C
options.text: The rabbit hiding under plants from loud noises

options.label: D
options.text: The rabbit nibbling on vegetation inside the habitat
